dn27:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati pubbārāme migāramātupāsāde.
dn27:1.3: tena kho pana samayena vāseṭṭhabhāradvājā bhikkhūsu parivasanti bhikkhubhāvaṃ ākaṅkhamānā.
dn27:1.4: athakho bhagavā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito pāsādā orohitvā pāsādapacchāyāyaṃ abbhokāse caṅkamati.
dn27:2.1: addasā kho vāseṭṭho bhagavantaṃ sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhitaṃ pāsādā orohitvā pāsādapacchāyāyaṃ abbhokāse caṅkamantaṃ
dn27:2.3: ayaṃ āvuso bhāradvāja bhagavā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito pāsādā orohitvā pāsādapacchāyāyaṃ abbhokāse caṅkamati
dn27:2.5: appevanāma labheyyāma bhagavato sammukhā dhammiṃ kathaṃ savanāyāti.
dn27:2.7: athakho vāseṭṭhabhāradvājā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā bhagavantaṃ caṅkamantaṃ anucaṅkamiṃsu.
dn27:3.2: tumhe khvattha vāseṭṭhā brāhmaṇajaccā brāhmaṇakulīnā brāhmaṇakulā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā kacci vo vāseṭṭhā 3 brāhmaṇā na akkosanti na paribhāsantīti.
dn27:3.3: taggha no bhante brāhmaṇā akkosanti paribhāsanti attarūpāya paribhāsāya paripuṇṇāya no aparipuṇṇāyāti.
dn27:3.4: yathākathaṃ pana vo vāseṭṭhā brāhmaṇā akkosanti paribhāsanti attarūpāya paribhāsāya paripuṇṇāya no aparipuṇṇāyāti.
dn27:3.6: brāhmaṇo va seṭṭho vaṇṇo hīnā aññe vaṇṇā
dn27:3.7: brāhmaṇo va sukko vaṇṇo kaṇhā aññe vaṇṇā
dn27:3.9: brāhmaṇā brahmuno puttā orasā mukhato jātā brahmajā brahmanimmitā brahmadāyādā
dn27:3.10: te tumhe seṭṭhaṃ vaṇṇaṃ hitvā hīnamatthavaṇṇaṃ ajjhupagatā yadidaṃ muṇḍake samaṇake ibbhe kaṇhe bandhupādā pacceti
dn27:3.11: tayidaṃ na sādhu tayidaṃ nappaṭirūpaṃ yaṃ tumhe seṭṭhaṃ vaṇṇaṃ hitvā hīnamatthavaṇṇaṃ ajjhupagatā yadidaṃ muṇḍake samaṇake ibbhe kaṇhe bandhupādā pacceti.
dn27:3.12: evaṃ kho no bhante brāhmaṇā akkosanti paribhāsanti attarūpāya paribhāsāya paripuṇṇāya no aparipuṇṇāyāti.
dn27:4.1: taggha vo vāseṭṭhā brāhmaṇā porāṇaṃ asarantā evamāhaṃsu
dn27:4.2: brāhmaṇo va seṭṭho vaṇṇo hīnā aññe vaṇṇā
dn27:4.3: brāhmaṇo va sukko vaṇṇo kaṇhā aññe vaṇṇā
dn27:4.5: brāhmaṇā brahmuno puttā orasā mukhato jātā brahmajā brahmanimmitā brahmadāyādāti.
dn27:4.6: dissanti kho pana vāseṭṭhā brāhmaṇānaṃ brāhmaṇiyo utuniyopi gabbhiniyopi vijāyamānāpi pāyamānāpi
dn27:4.7: te ca brāhmaṇā yonijā va samānā evamāhaṃsu
dn27:4.12: te ca brahmānañceva abbhācikkhanti musā ca bhāsanti bahuñca apuññaṃ pasavanti.

dn27:7.1: imesu kho vāseṭṭhā catūsu vaṇṇesu evaṃubhayabyokiṇṇesu vattamānesu kaṇhasukkesu dhammesu viññuvigarahitesu ceva viññupasatthesu ca yadettha brāhmaṇā evamāhaṃsu
dn27:7.2: brāhmaṇo va seṭṭho vaṇṇo hīnā aññe vaṇṇā
dn27:7.3: brāhmaṇo va sukko vaṇṇo kaṇhā aññe vaṇṇā
dn27:7.5: brāhmaṇā brahmuno puttā orasā mukhato jātā brahmajā brahmanimmitā brahmadāyādāti.
dn27:7.8: imesaṃ hi vāseṭṭhā catunnaṃ vaṇṇānaṃ yo hoti bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇāsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇakavasaññojano sammadaññāvimutto so nesaṃ aggamakkhāyati dhammeneva no adhammena.
dn27:7.9: dhammo hi vāseṭṭhā seṭṭho janetasmiṃ diṭṭhe ceva dhamme abhisamparāyañca.
dn27:7.10: tadamināpetaṃ vāseṭṭhā pariyāyena veditabbaṃ yathā dhammo seṭṭho janetasmiṃ diṭṭhe ceva dhamme abhisamparāyañca.
dn27:8.1: jānāti kho vāseṭṭhā rājā pasenadi kosalo
dn27:8.3: sakyā kho pana vāseṭṭhā rañño pasenadissa kosalassa anantarā anuyantā bhavanti.
dn27:8.4: karonti kho vāseṭṭhā sakyā raññe pasenadimhi kosale nipaccakāraṃ abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ añjalikammaṃ sāmīcikammaṃ.
dn27:8.5: iti kho vāseṭṭhā yaṃ karonti sakyā raññe pasenadimhi kosale nipaccakāraṃ abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ añjalikammaṃ sāmīcikammaṃ karoti taṃ rājā pasenadi kosalo tathāgate nipaccakāraṃ abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ añjalikammaṃ sāmīcikammaṃ nanu sujāto samaṇo gotamo dujjātohamasmi
dn27:8.9: athakho naṃ dhammaṃyeva sakkaronto dhammaṃ garukaronto dhammaṃ mānento dhammaṃ pūjento dhammaṃ apacayamāno. evaṃ rājā pasenadi kosalo tathāgate nipaccakāraṃ karoti abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ añjalikammaṃ sāmīcikammaṃ.
dn27:8.10: iminā kho evaṃ vāseṭṭhā pariyāyena veditabbaṃ yathā dhammo seṭṭho janetasmiṃ diṭṭhe ceva dhamme abhisamparāyañca.
dn27:9.1: tumhe khvattha vāseṭṭhā nānājaccā nānānāmā nānāgottā nānākulā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā
dn27:9.2: ke tumheti puṭṭhā samānā samaṇā sakyaputtiyāmhāti paṭijānāthāti.
dn27:9.3: yassa kho panassa vāseṭṭhā tathāgate saddhā niviṭṭhā mūlajātā patiṭṭhitā daḷhā asaṃhāriyā 2 samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā devena vā mārena vā brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasmiṃ tassetaṃ kallaṃ vācāya
dn27:9.4: bhagavatomhi putto oraso mukhato jāto dhammajo dhammanimmito dhammadāyādoti.
dn27:9.6: tathāgatassa hetaṃ vāseṭṭhā adhivacanaṃ dhammakāyo itipi brahmakāyo itipi dhammabhūto itipi brahmabhūto itipi.
dn27:10.1: hoti kho so vāseṭṭhā samayo yaṃ kadāci karahaci dīghassa addhuno accayena ayaṃ loko saṃvaṭṭati
dn27:10.2: saṃvaṭṭamāne loke yebhuyyena sattā ābhassarasaṃvattanikā honti
dn27:10.3: te tattha manomayā pītibhakkhā sayaṃpabhā antalikkhacarā subhaṭṭhāyino ciraṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ tiṭṭhanti.
dn27:10.4: hoti kho so vāseṭṭhā samayo yaṃ kadāci karahaci dīghassa addhuno accayena ayaṃ loko vivaṭṭati
dn27:10.5: vivaṭṭamāne loke yebhuyyena sattā ābhassarakāyā cavitvā itthattaṃ āgacchanti
dn27:10.6: te ca honti manomayā pītibhakkhā sayaṃpabhā antalikkhacarā subhaṭṭhāyino ciraṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ tiṭṭhanti.
dn27:11.1: kho pana vāseṭṭhā tena samayena hoti andhakāro andhakāratimisā
dn27:11.2: na candimasuriyā paññāyanti na nakkhattāni tārakarūpāni paññāyanti na rattindivā paññāyanti na māsaddhamāsā paññāyanti na utusaṃvaccharā paññāyanti na itthīpurisā paññāyanti. sattā sattātveva saṅkhyaṃ gacchanti.
dn27:11.3: athakho tesaṃ vāseṭṭhā sattānaṃ kadāci karahaci dīghassa addhuno accayena rasapaṭhavī udakasmiṃ samantāni
dn27:11.4: seyyathāpi nāma payatattassa nibbāyamānassa upari santānakaṃ hoti
dn27:11.6: sā ahosi vaṇṇasampannā gandhasampannā rasasampannā seyyathāpi nāma sampannā vā sappi sampannaṃ vā navanītaṃ evaṃvaṇṇā ahosi
dn27:11.10: ambho kimevidaṃ bhavissatīti rasapaṭhaviṃ aṅguliyā sāyi
dn27:11.11: tassa rasapaṭhaviṃ aṅguliyā sāyato acchādesi taṇhāpassa okkami.
dn27:11.12: aññepi kho vāseṭṭhā sattā tassa sattassa diṭṭhānugatiṃ āpajjamānā rasapaṭhaviṃ aṅguliyā sāyiṃsu.
dn27:11.13: tesaṃ rasapaṭhaviṃ aṅguliyā sāyataṃ acchādeti taṇhā ca nesaṃ okkami.
dn27:12.1: te vāseṭṭhā sattā rasapaṭhaviṃ hatthehi āluppakārakaṃ upakkamiṃsu paribhuñjituṃ.
dn27:12.2: yato kho vāseṭṭhā sattā rasapaṭhaviṃ hatthehi āluppakārakaṃ upakkamiṃsu paribhuñjituṃ
dn27:12.9: ettāvatā kho vāseṭṭhā ayaṃ loko puna vivaṭṭo hoti.
dn27:13.1: athakho te vāseṭṭhā sattā rasapaṭhaviṃ paribhuñjantā tabbhakkhā tadāhārā ciraṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu.
dn27:13.2: yathā yathā kho te vāseṭṭhā sattā rasapaṭhaviṃ paribhuñjantā tabbhakkhā tadāhārā ciraṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu tathā tathā tesaṃ sattānaṃ kharattañceva kāyasmiṃ okkami vaṇṇavevaṇṇatā ca paññāyittha.
dn27:13.3: ekidaṃ sattā vaṇṇavanto honti ekidaṃ sattā dubbaṇṇā.
dn27:13.4: tattha ye te sattā vaṇṇavanto te dubbaṇṇe satte atimaññanti
dn27:13.10: tadetarahipi manussā kiñcideva surasaṃ labhitvā evamāhaṃsu
dn27:13.12: tadeva porāṇaṃ aggaññaṃ akkharaṃ anussaranti na tvevassa atthaṃ ājānanti.
dn27:14.1: tesaṃ vāseṭṭhā sattānaṃ rasapaṭhaviyā antarahitāya bhūmipappaṭiko pāturahosi.
dn27:14.3: so ahosi vaṇṇasampanno gandhasampanno rasasampanno seyyathāpi nāma sampannā vā sappi sampannaṃ vā navanītaṃ evaṃvaṇṇo ahosi
dn27:14.4: seyyathāpi nāma khuddamadhadha aneḷakaṃ evamassādo ahosi.
dn27:14.5: athakho te vāseṭṭhā sattā bhūmipappaṭikaṃ upakkamiṃsu paribhuñjituṃ
dn27:14.6: te paribhuñjantā tabbhakkhā tadāhārā ciraṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu.
dn27:14.7: yathā yathā kho te vāseṭṭhā sattā bhūmipappaṭikaṃ paribhuñjantā tabbhakkhā tadāhārā ciraṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu tathā tathā tesaṃ sattānaṃ bhiyyoso mattāya kharattañceva kāyasmiṃ okkami vaṇṇavevaṇṇatā ca paññāyittha.
dn27:14.8: ekidaṃ sattā vaṇṇavanto honti ekidaṃ sattā dubbaṇṇā.
dn27:14.9: tattha ye te sattā vaṇṇavanto te bubbaṇṇe satte atimaññanti
dn27:14.13: antarahite padālatā pāturahosi. seyyathāpi nāma kalambakā evamevaṃ pāturahosi.
dn27:14.14: sā ahosi vaṇṇasampannā gandhasampannā rasasampannā seyyathāpi nāma sampannā vā sappi sampannaṃ vā navanītaṃ evaṃvaṇṇā ahosi
dn27:14.15: seyyathāpi nāma khuddamadhadha aneḷakaṃ evamassādā ahosi.
dn27:15.1: athakho te vāseṭṭhā sattā padālataṃ upakkamiṃsu paribhuñjituṃ
dn27:15.2: te paribhuñjantā tabbhakkhā tadāhārā ciraṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu.
dn27:15.3: yathā yathā kho te vāseṭṭhā sattā padālataṃ paribhuñjantā tabbhakkhā tadāhārā ciraṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu tathā tathā tesaṃ sattānaṃ bhiyyoso mattāya kharattañceva kāyasmiṃ okkami vaṇṇavevaṇṇatā ca paññāyittha.
dn27:15.4: ekidaṃ sattā vaṇṇavanto honti ekidaṃ sattā dubbaṇṇā.
dn27:15.5: tattha ye te sattā vaṇṇavanto te dubbaṇṇe satte atimaññanti
dn27:15.9: ahu vata no ahāyi vata no padālatāti.
dn27:15.10: tadetarahi manussā kenacideva dukkhadhammena phuṭṭhā evamāhaṃsu
dn27:15.11: ahu vata no ahāyi vata noti.
dn27:15.12: tadeva porāṇaṃ aggaññaṃ akkharaṃ anussaranti na tvevassa atthaṃ ājānanti.
dn27:16.1: tesaṃ vāseṭṭhā sattānaṃ padālatāya antarahitāya akaṭṭhapāko sāli pāturahosi akaṇo athuso suddho sugandho taṇḍulapphalo.
dn27:16.2: yantaṃ sāyaṃ sāyamāsāya āharanti pāto taṃ hoti pakkaṃ paṭiviruḷhaṃ
dn27:16.3: yantaṃ pāto pātarāsāya āharanti sāyaṃ taṃ hoti pakkaṃ paṭiviruḷhaṃ
dn27:16.5: athakho vāseṭṭhā sattā akaṭṭhapākaṃ sāliṃ paribhuñjantā tabbhakkhā tadāhārā ciraṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu.
dn27:16.7: yathā yathā kho te vāseṭṭhā sattā akaṭṭhapākaṃ sāliṃ paribhuñjantā tabbhakkhā tadāhārā ciraṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu tathā tathā tesaṃ sattānaṃ bhiyyoso mattāya kharattañceva kāyasmiṃ okkami vaṇṇavevaṇṇatā ca paññāyittha. itthiyā ca itthīliṅgaṃ pāturahosi purisassa purisaliṅgaṃ.
dn27:16.8: itthī ca sudaṃ ativelaṃ purisaṃ upanijjhāyati puriso ca itthiṃ.
dn27:16.9: tesaṃ ativelaṃ aññamaññaṃ upanijjhāyantānaṃ sārāgo udapādi pariḷāho kāyasmiṃ okkami.
dn27:16.11: ye kho pana te vāseṭṭhā tena samayena sattā passanti methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevante aññe paṃsuṃ khipanti aññe seṭṭhiṃ khipanti aññe gomayaṃ khipanti
dn27:16.13: kathañhi nāma satto sattassa evarūpaṃ karissatīti.
dn27:16.14: tadetarahipi manussā ekaccesu janapadesu vadhaniyā nibbuyhamānāya aññe paṃsuṃ khipanti aññe seṭṭhiṃ khipanti aññe gomayaṃ khipanti.
dn27:16.15: tadeva porāṇaṃ aggaññaṃ akkharaṃ anussaranti na tvevassa atthaṃ ājānanti.
dn27:17.1: adhammasammataṃ taṃ kho pana vāseṭṭhā tena samayena hoti tadetarahi dhammasammataṃ.
dn27:17.2: ye kho pana te vāseṭṭhā tena samayena sattā methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevanti temāsaṃpi dvemāsaṃpi na labhanti gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā pavisituṃ.
dn27:17.3: yato kho vāseṭṭhā te sattā tasmiṃ asaddhamme ativelaṃ pātabyataṃ āpajjiṃsu
dn27:17.4: atha agārāni upakkamiṃsu kātuṃ tasseva asaddhammassa paṭicchādanatthaṃ.
dn27:17.5: athakho vāseṭṭhā aññatarassa sattassa alasajātikassa etadahosi
dn27:17.6: ambho kimevāhaṃ vihaññāmi sāliṃ āharanto sāyaṃ sāyamāsāya pāto pātarāsāya
dn27:17.8: pātarāsāyāti. athakho so vāseṭṭhā satto sāliṃ āhāsi sakideva sāyaṃ
dn27:17.9: pātarāsāyāti. athakho vāseṭṭhā aññataro satto yena so satto tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā taṃ sattaṃ etadavoca
dn27:17.11: alaṃ bho satta āhaṭo me sāli sakideva sāyaṃ
dn27:17.12: pātarāsāyāti. athakho so vāseṭṭhā satto tassa sattassa diṭṭhānugatiṃ āpajjamāno sāliṃ āhāsi sakideva dvīhāya evaṃpi kira bho sādhūti.
dn27:17.13: athakho vāseṭṭhā aññataro satto yena so satto tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā taṃ sattaṃ etadavoca
dn27:17.15: alaṃ bho satta āhaṭo me sāli sakideva sāyaṃ
dn27:17.16: pātarāsāyāti. athakho so vāseṭṭhā satto tassa sattassa diṭṭhānugatiṃ āpajjamāno sāliṃ āhāsi sakideva catūhāya evaṃ kira bho sādhūti.
dn27:17.17: athakho vāseṭṭhā aññataro satto yena so satto tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā taṃ sattaṃ etadavoca
dn27:17.19: alaṃ bho satta āhaṭo me sāli sakideva catūhāyāti.
dn27:17.20: athakho so vāseṭṭhā satto tassa sattassa diṭṭhānugatiṃ āpajjamāno sāliṃ āhāsi sakideva aṭṭhāhāya evaṃ kira bho sādhūti.
dn27:17.21: yato kho te vāseṭṭhā sattā sannidhikārakaṃ sāliṃ upakkamiṃsu paribhuñjituṃ.
dn27:17.22: athakho vāseṭṭhā kaṇo taṇḍulaṃ pariyonaddhi thusopi taṇḍulaṃ pariyonaddhi
dn27:17.23: lunaṃpi nappaṭiviruḷhaṃ apadānaṃ paññāyittha saṇḍasaṇḍā sālayo aṭṭhaṃsu.
dn27:18.1: te vāseṭṭhā sattā sannipatiṃsu sannipatitvā anutthaniṃsu
dn27:18.2: pāpakā vata bho dhammā sattesu pātubhūtā
dn27:18.3: mayaṃ hi pubbe manomayā ahumhā pītibhakkhā sayaṃpabhā antalikkhacarā subhaṭṭhāyino ciraṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ aṭṭhamhā
dn27:18.4: tesaṃ no amhākaṃ kadāci karahaci ciraṃ dīghassa addhuno accayena rasapaṭhavī udakasmiṃ samantāni
dn27:18.6: te mayaṃ rasapaṭhaviṃ hatthehi āluppakārakaṃ upakkamimhā paribhuñjituṃ tesanno rasapaṭhaviṃ hatthehi āluppakārakaṃ upakkamataṃ paribhuñjituṃ sayaṃpabhā antaradhāyi
dn27:18.7: sayaṃpabhāya antarahitāya candimasuriyā pāturahesuṃ candimasuriyesu pātubhūtesu nakkhattāni tārakarūpāni pāturahesuṃ nakkhattesu tārakarūpesu pātubhūtesu rattindivā paññāyiṃsu rattindivesu paññāyamānesu māsaddhamāsā paññāyiṃsu
dn27:18.9: te mayaṃ rasapaṭhaviṃ paribhuñjantā tabbhakkhā tadāhārā ciraṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ aṭṭhamhā
dn27:18.10: tesaṃ no pāpakānaṃyeva akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pātubhāvā rasapaṭhavī antaradhāyi
dn27:18.14: te mayaṃ taṃ paribhuñjantā tabbhakkhā tadāhārā ciraṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ aṭṭhamhā
dn27:18.15: tesaṃ no pāpakānaṃyeva akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pātubhāvā bhūmipappaṭiko antaradhāyi
dn27:18.19: te mayaṃ taṃ paribhuñjantā tabbhakkhā tadāhārā ciraṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ aṭṭhamhā
dn27:18.20: tesaṃ no pāpakānaṃyeva akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pātubhāvā padālatā antaradhāyi
dn27:18.21: padālatāya antarahitāya akaṭṭhapāko sāli pāturahosi akaṇo athuso suddho sugandho taṇḍulapphalo
dn27:18.22: yantaṃ sāyaṃ sāyamāsāya āharāma pāto taṃ hoti pakkaṃ paṭiviruḷhaṃ
dn27:18.23: yantaṃ pāto pātarāsāya āharāma sāyantaṃ hoti pakkaṃ paṭiviruḷhaṃ
dn27:18.25: te mayaṃ akaṭṭhapākaṃ sāliṃ paribhuñjantā tabbhakkhā tadāhārā ciraṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ aṭṭhamhā
dn27:18.26: tesanno pāpakānaṃyeva akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pātubhāvā kaṇopi taṇḍulaṃ pariyonaddhi thusopi taṇḍulaṃ pariyonaddhi lūnaṃpi nappaṭiviruḷhaṃ apadānampi paññāyittha saṇḍasaṇḍā sālayo ṭhitā
dn27:18.27: yannūna mayaṃ sāliṃ vibhajeyyāma mariyādaṃ ṭhapeyyāmāti.
dn27:18.28: athakho vāseṭṭhā sattā sāliṃ vibhajiṃsu mariyādaṃ ṭhapesuṃ.
dn27:19.1: athakho vāseṭṭhā aññataro satto lolajātiko sakaṃ bhāgaṃ parirakkhanto aññataraṃ bhāgaṃ adinnaṃ ādiyitvā paribhuñji.
dn27:19.3: pāpakaṃ vata bho satta karosi yatra hi nāma sakaṃ bhāgaṃ parirakkhanto aññataraṃ bhāgaṃ adinnaṃ ādiyitvā paribhuñjasi
dn27:19.5: evaṃ bhoti kho vāseṭṭhā so satto tesaṃ sattānaṃ paccassosi.
dn27:19.7: tatiyampi kho vāseṭṭhā so satto sakaṃ bhāgaṃ parirakkhanto aññataraṃ bhāgaṃ adinnaṃ ādiyitvā paribhuñji.
dn27:19.9: pāpakaṃ vata bho satta karosi yatra hi nāma sakaṃ bhāgaṃ parirakkhanto aññataraṃ bhāgaṃ adinnaṃ ādiyitvā paribhuñji
dn27:19.10: mā bho satta punapi evarūpaṃ akāsīti.
dn27:19.11: aññe pāṇinā pahariṃsu aññe leḍḍunā pahariṃsu aññe daṇḍena pahariṃsu.
dn27:19.12: tadagge kho pana vāseṭṭhā adinnādānaṃ paññāyati garahā paññāyati musāvādo paññāyati daṇḍādānaṃ paññāyati.
dn27:20.2: pāpakā vata bho dhammā sattesu pātubhūtā yatra hi nāma adinnādānaṃ paññāyissati garahā paññāyissati musāvādo paññāyissati daṇḍādānaṃ paññāyissati
dn27:20.3: yannūna mayaṃ ekaṃ sattaṃ sammanneyyāma yo no sammākhīyitabbaṃ khīyeyya sammāgarahitabbaṃ garaheyya sammāpabbājetabbaṃ pabbājeyya
dn27:20.5: athakho te vāseṭṭhā sattā yo nesaṃ satto abhirūpataro ca dassanīyataro ca pāsādikataro ca mahesakkhataro ca taṃ sattaṃ upasaṅkamitvā etadavocuṃ
dn27:20.6: ehi bho satta sammākhīyitabbaṃ khīyi sammāgarahitabbaṃ garahi sammāpabbājetabbaṃ pabbājehi
dn27:20.7: mayaṃ pana vo sālīnaṃ bhāgaṃ anupadassāmāti.
dn27:20.8: evaṃ bhoti kho so vāseṭṭhā satto tesaṃ sattānaṃ paṭissutvā sammākhīyitabbaṃ khīyi sammāgarahitabbaṃ garahi sammāpabbājetabbaṃ pabbājesi.
dn27:21.1: mahājanasammatoti kho vāseṭṭhā mahāsammatotveva paṭhamaṃ akkharaṃ upanibbattaṃ.
dn27:21.2: khettānaṃ adhipatīti kho vāseṭṭhā khattiyo khattiyotveva dutiyaṃ akkharaṃ upanibbattaṃ.
dn27:21.3: dhammena paresaṃ rañjetīti kho vāseṭṭhā rājā rājātveva tatiyaṃ akkharaṃ upanibbattaṃ.
dn27:21.4: iti kho vāseṭṭhā evamevassa khattiyamaṇḍalassa porāṇena aggaññena akkharena abhinibbatti ahosi. tesaṃyeva sattānaṃ aññesaṃ sadisānaṃyeva no asadisānaṃ dhammeneva no adhammena.
dn27:21.5: dhammo hi vāseṭṭhā seṭṭho janetasmiṃ diṭṭhe ceva dhamme abhisamparāyañca.
dn27:22.2: pāpakā vata bho dhammā sattesu pātubhūtā yatra hi nāma adinnādānaṃ paññāyissati garahā paññāyissati musāvādo paññāyissati daṇḍādānaṃ paññāyissati pabbājanaṃ paññāyissati
dn27:22.3: yannūna mayaṃ pāpake akusale dhamme vāheyyāmāti.
dn27:22.5: pāpake akusale dhamme vāhentīti kho vāseṭṭhā brāhmaṇātveva paṭhamaṃ akkharaṃ upanibbattaṃ.
dn27:22.6: te araññāyatane paṇṇakuṭiyo ca karitvā paṇṇakuṭīsu jhāyanti. vītaṅgārā vītadhūmā paṇṇamusalā sāyaṃ sāyamāsāya pāto pātarāsāya gāmanigamarājadhāniyo osaranti ghāsamesanā.
dn27:22.7: te ghāsaṃ paṭilabhitvā punadeva araññāyatane paṇṇakuṭīsu jhāyanti.
dn27:22.9: ime kho bho sattā araññāyatane paṇṇakuṭiyo karitvā paṇṇakuṭīsu jhāyanti vītaṅgārā vītadhūmā paṇṇamusalā sāyaṃ sāyamāsāya pāto pātarāsāya gāmanigamarājadhāniyo osaranti ghāsamesanā.
dn27:22.10: te ghāsampaṭilabhitvā punadeva araññāyatane paṇṇakuṭīsu jhāyanti.
dn27:22.11: te kho vāseṭṭhā jhāyikā jhāyikātveva dutiyaṃ akkharaṃ upanibbattaṃ
dn27:23.1: tesaṃyeva kho vāseṭṭhā sattānaṃ ekacce sattā araññāyatane paṇṇakuṭīsu jhānaṃ anabhisambhunamānā gāmasāmantaṃ nigamasāmantaṃ osaritvā gaṇṭhe karontā āgacchanti.
dn27:23.3: ime kho pana bho sattā araññāyatane paṇṇakuṭīsu jhānaṃ anabhisambhunamānā gāmasāmantaṃ nigamasāmantaṃ osaritvā gaṇṭhe karontā gacchanti. nadānime jhāyanti
dn27:23.4: nadānime jhāyantīti kho vāseṭṭhā ajjhāyikā ajjhāyikātveva tatiyaṃ akkharaṃ upanibbattaṃ.
dn27:23.5: hīnasammataṃ kho pana vāseṭṭhā tena samayena hoti tadetarahi seṭṭhasammataṃ.
dn27:23.6: iti kho vāseṭṭhā evametassa brāhmaṇamaṇḍalassa porāṇena aggaññena akkharena abhinibbatti ahosi tesaṃyeva sattānaṃ aññesaṃ sadisānaṃyeva no asadisānaṃ dhammeneva no adhammena.
dn27:23.7: dhammo hi vāseṭṭhā seṭṭho janetasmiṃ diṭṭhe ceva dhamme abhisamparāyañca.
dn27:24.1: tesaṃyeva kho vāseṭṭhā sattānaṃ ekacce sattā methunaṃ dhammaṃ samādāya visuṃ kammante payojesuṃ.
dn27:24.2: methunaṃ dhammaṃ samādāya visuṃ kammante payojentīti kho vāseṭṭhā vessā vessātveva akkharaṃ nibbattaṃ.
dn27:25.3: iti kho vāseṭṭhā evametassa suddamaṇḍalassa porāṇena aggaññena akkharena abhinibbatti ahosi tesaṃyeva sattānaṃ aññesaṃ sadisānaṃyeva no asadisānaṃ dhammeneva no adhammena.
dn27:25.4: dhammo hi vāseṭṭhā seṭṭho janetasmiṃ diṭṭhe ceva dhamme abhisamparāyañca.
dn27:26.1: ahu kho so vāseṭṭhā samayo yaṃ khattiyopi sakaṃ dhammaṃ garahamāno agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati
dn27:26.5: suddopi kho sakaṃ dhammaṃ garahamāno agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati
dn27:26.7: imehi kho vāseṭṭhā catūhi maṇḍalehi samaṇamaṇḍalassa abhinibbatti ahosi tesaṃyeva sattānaṃ aññesaṃ sadisānaṃyeva no asadisānaṃ dhammeneva no adhammena.
dn27:26.8: dhammo hi vāseṭṭhā seṭṭho janetasmiṃ diṭṭhe ceva dhamme abhisamparāyañca.
dn27:27.1: khattiyopi kho vāseṭṭhā kāyena duccaritañcaritvā vācāya duccaritañcaritvā manasā duccaritañcaritvā micchādiṭṭhiko micchādiṭṭhikammasamādāno micchādiṭṭhikammasamādānahetu kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati.
dn27:27.5: samaṇopi kho vāseṭṭhā kāyena duccaritañcaritvā vācāya duccaritañcaritvā manasā duccaritañcaritvā micchādiṭṭhiko micchādiṭṭhikammasamādāno micchādiṭṭhikammasamādānahetu kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati.
dn27:28.1: khattiyopi kho vāseṭṭhā kāyena sucaritañcaritvā vācāya sucaritañcaritvā manasā sucaritañcaritvā sammādiṭṭhiko sammādiṭṭhikammasamādāno sammādiṭṭhikammasamādānahetu kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati.
dn27:28.5: samaṇopi kho vāseṭṭhā kāyena sucaritañcaritvā vācāya sucaritañcaritvā manasā sucaritañcaritvā sammādiṭṭhiko sammādiṭṭhikammasamādāno sammādiṭṭhikammasamādānahetu kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati.
dn27:29.1: khattiyopi kho vāseṭṭhā kāyena dvayakārī vācāya dvayakārī manasā dvayakārī vimissadiṭṭhiko vimissakammasamādāno vimissakammasamādānahetu kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sukhadukkhapaṭisaṃvedī hoti.
dn27:29.2: brāhmaṇopi kho vāseṭṭhā kāyena dvayakārī vācāya dvayakārī manasā dvayakārī vimissadiṭṭhiko vimissakammasamādāno vimissakammasamādānahetu kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sukhadukkhapaṭisaṃvedī hoti.
dn27:29.3: vessopi kho vāseṭṭhā kāyena dvayakārī vācāya dvayakārī manasā dvayakārī vimissadiṭṭhiko vimissakammasamādāno vimissakammasamādānahetu kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sukhadukkhapaṭisaṃvedī hoti.
dn27:29.4: suddopi kho vāseṭṭhā kāyena dvayakārī vācāya dvayakārī manasā dvayakārī vimissadiṭṭhiko vimissakammasamādāno vimissakammasamādānahetu kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sukhadukkhapaṭisaṃvedī hoti.
dn27:29.5: samaṇopi kho vāseṭṭhā kāyena dvayakārī vācāya dvayakārī manasā dvayakārī vimissadiṭṭhiko vimissakammasamādāno vimissakammasamādānahetu kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sukhadukkhapaṭisaṃvedī hoti.
dn27:30.1: khattiyopi kho vāseṭṭhā kāyena saṃvuto vācāya saṃvuto manasā saṃvuto sattannaṃ bodhipakkhiyānaṃ dhammānaṃ bhāvanamanvāya diṭṭheyeva dhamme parinibbāyati.
dn27:30.5: kho vāseṭṭhā kāyena saṃvuto vācāya saṃvuto manasā saṃvuto sattannaṃ bodhipakkhiyānaṃ dhammānaṃ bhāvanamanvāya diṭṭheyeva dhamme parinibbāyati.
dn27:31.1: vessopi kho vāseṭṭhā kāyena saṃvuto vācāya saṃvuto manasā saṃvuto sattannaṃ bodhipakkhiyānaṃ dhammānaṃ bhāvanamanvāya diṭṭheyeva dhamme parinibbāyati. suddopi kho vāseṭṭhā kāyena saṃvuto vācāya saṃvuto manasā saṃvuto sattannaṃ bodhipakkhiyānaṃ dhammānaṃ bhāvanamanvāya diṭṭheyeva dhamme parinibbāyati. imesaṃ hi vāseṭṭhā catunnaṃ vaṇṇānaṃ yo hoti bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇāsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaññojano sammadaññāvimutto so nesaṃ aggamakkhāyati dhammeneva no adhammena.
dn27:31.2: dhammo hi vāseṭṭhā seṭṭho janetasmiṃ diṭṭhe ceva dhamme abhisamparāyañca.
dn27:32.6: sāpi kho panesā vāseṭṭhā brahmunā sanaṅkumārena gāthā sugītā no duggītā subhāsitā no dubbhāsitā atthasañhitā no anatthasañhitā anumatā mayā.
